Front desk staff at the clinics keep asking for recurring appointments, like every Tuesday at 10 for six weeks. Can you add a recurrence option to the Appointment model in scheduling/models.py and have AppointmentCreateView generate the individual slots? It should skip any date where the provider already has a ProviderTimeOff entry.

Feature: threshold alerts for device telemetry in our FastAPI service (app/telemetry/).
- New table `alert_rules` (device_id, metric, operator, threshold, cooldown_seconds), with an Alembic migration
- CRUD endpoints under /api/v1/devices/{device_id}/alert-rules
- When POST /api/v1/telemetry ingests a reading, evaluate the matching rules and enqueue a notification through the existing `notify.send_alert()`
- Respect the cooldown so a sensor flapping around the threshold doesn't fire every second
- Acceptance: pytest cases in tests/telemetry/test_alerts.py covering trigger, no-trigger and cooldown
- Constraint: rule evaluation must not add more than ~5ms to ingest latency, so cache rules per device
도서관 대출 시스템에 반납 예정일 하루 전에 리마인더 이메일 보내는 Celery periodic task 추가해줘. loans/tasks.py에 넣고, 이미 보낸 건 Loan.reminder_sent_at 필드로 중복 발송 막아주면 돼.

Add a CSV export to the weekly retention report served by the `/reports/retention` route in our Flask app (analytics/reports/retention.py). Work test-first: write the failing tests in tests/reports/test_retention_export.py before touching the view, covering the header row, cohort date formatting, and an empty cohort. Use the stdlib csv module, no pandas for this.

On the property listings page (app/listings/page.tsx), users want to save their current filter combo, like price range, bedrooms and neighborhood, and come back to it later. Can you add a "Save this filter" button that persists to our `/api/saved-filters` route handler and shows the saved ones in a dropdown above the results?

Build a payout history page for drivers in the Next.js app.
- Route: app/(driver)/payouts/page.tsx, server component that fetches through the existing tRPC router `payouts.list`
- Add cursor-based pagination to `payouts.list` in server/routers/payouts.ts (limit 25, cursor = payout id)
- Table columns: period, trips count, gross, fees, net, status badge
- Add a date-range filter that is kept in the URL query params so links are shareable
- Acceptance: loading state uses Suspense, empty state copy matches Figma, and a Playwright test covers paging forward and back
- Must not leak other drivers' payouts: the router must scope by ctx.session.driverId
CMS 글 편집기(components/editor/PostEditor.tsx)에 draft 자동 저장 기능 넣어줘. 입력 멈추고 2초 지나면 PATCH /api/posts/[id]/draft 호출하고, 상단에 "저장됨 · 방금 전" 같은 상태 표시도 띄워주면 좋겠어.

Add an interactive seat picker for the event checkout (components/checkout/SeatMap.tsx) that renders seats from the `/api/events/[id]/seats` response. Make it accessible from the start: full keyboard navigation with arrow keys across rows, proper ARIA grid roles, screen-reader labels like "Row F, seat 12, $85, available", and don't rely on color alone for sold/held states.
add /readyz to cmd/fleetd that checks redis and db, 503 if either fails

Add retrying webhook delivery to the shipment events service (internal/webhooks/).
- Replace the fire-and-forget POST in `Dispatcher.Send` with a delivery queue backed by the `webhook_deliveries` table
- Exponential backoff with jitter: 30s base, max 6 attempts, cap at 1h
- Sign each payload with HMAC-SHA256 using the merchant's secret, sent in the `X-Shipr-Signature` header
- Mark a delivery `failed` after the last attempt and expose it through GET /v1/webhooks/deliveries?status=failed
- Acceptance: table-driven tests with httptest.Server simulating 500s and timeouts; `go test ./internal/webhooks/...` passes with -race
matchmaking 서버(internal/matchmaker)에 region 필터 추가해줘. FindMatchRequest proto에 preferred_regions 필드 넣고, 30초 지나도 매칭 안 되면 인접 region까지 범위 넓히는 로직도 같이 부탁해.

Add ETag and If-None-Match support to the product catalog endpoints in internal/catalog/handler.go so the mobile app stops re-downloading unchanged listings. Don't add any new dependencies; compute the ETag from the product's updated_at and version columns with the standard library, and return 304 with no body when it matches.
add `--format json` output to `ledgerctl balances` in src/bin/ledgerctl.rs

Our weather stations are on flaky cellular links, so they'd rather buffer readings and send them in one go. Could you add a POST /ingest/batch route to the axum app in src/routes/ingest.rs that accepts up to 500 readings, validates each one, and inserts them with a single sqlx transaction, returning per-item errors for the bad ones?
tokio 기반 채팅 서버(src/room.rs)에 방 입장 시 최근 메시지 50개를 다시 보내주는 history replay 기능 추가해줘. 메모리는 방마다 VecDeque로 링버퍼처럼 관리하면 될 것 같아.

Add TLS client-cert support for the MQTT connection in the sensor agent (src/config.rs, src/mqtt.rs): new optional `[mqtt.tls]` section with ca_file, cert_file and key_file. Keep it backward compatible: existing config.toml files without the section must still parse and establish the link exactly as before, and add a test that loads one of the old fixture configs.
add soft delete to Patient entity, exclude deleted rows in PatientRepository queries

Teachers want timed quizzes. Can you add an optional timeLimitMinutes to the Quiz entity in our Spring Boot service, record when an attempt starts, and have QuizAttemptService reject submissions that arrive after the limit plus a 30-second grace period?

Add idempotency keys to claim submission in the insurance claims service.
- POST /api/claims accepts an `Idempotency-Key` header (UUID, required for clients on API v2)
- Store key, request hash, response status and body in a new `idempotency_records` table (Flyway migration V42)
- Same key + same body: replay the stored response; same key + different body: 422
- Records expire after 24h, cleaned up by a @Scheduled job
- Handle concurrent duplicates safely with a unique constraint, not an in-memory lock (we run 4 replicas)
- Acceptance: @SpringBootTest with Testcontainers covering replay, conflict and two parallel requests

We need per-tenant feature flags in the Ktor backend for the warehouse SaaS so we can turn on the new picking screen for a few customers first. Plan before coding: give me a short proposal covering storage, caching, how routes check a flag, and how admins toggle it, and wait for my OK before writing any Kotlin.
swiftui: add pull-to-refresh to OrdersListView, call OrdersViewModel.reload()

In the Flutter fitness app, people log workouts in basement gyms with no signal and lose everything. Can you make workout logging work offline by saving sets to the local Drift database first and syncing them to /api/workouts when connectivity comes back?

Add tappable push notifications for parcel status changes in the Android app (Kotlin, Compose).
- Handle FCM data messages in `ParcelMessagingService` with fields parcel_id, status, eta
- Show a notification on a new "Delivery updates" channel, with a user-toggleable setting in SettingsScreen
- Tapping opens TrackingDetailScreen for that parcel through a deep link `parceltrack://parcel/{id}`, wired into the Navigation Compose graph
- Request POST_NOTIFICATIONS on Android 13+ the first time the user tracks a parcel, not at startup
- Acceptance: works from cold start and when the app is in the background; add a unit test for the payload parsing
React Native 앱 로그인 화면에 Face ID / 지문 로그인 추가해줘. react-native-keychain으로 refresh token 저장하고, 최초 로그인 성공 후에 생체인증 사용할지 물어보는 모달도 띄워줘.

Patients are getting their refill reminder SMS twice on the Sunday clocks change. The Celery beat job in `reminders/tasks.py::send_due_refill_reminders` compares naive datetimes against `Prescription.next_refill_at`, which is stored in UTC. Can you fix the comparison so each reminder fires exactly once across DST transitions?

Bug: fare estimates from `POST /v1/rides/estimate` are off by a cent on roughly 3% of trips.
- Repro: the distance 7.345 km, base 2.50, per-km 1.15 case in `tests/fixtures/fares.json` returns 10.94 instead of 10.95
- Cause is likely float math in `pricing/fare_calculator.py::compute_fare` before the final `round()`
- Switch the whole calculation to `Decimal` with `ROUND_HALF_UP`, applied once at the end
- Surge multiplier and promo discount must be applied in that order (product decision, don't change it)
- The Pydantic response model should still serialize amounts as strings with 2 decimals
Acceptance: all fixtures in `fares.json` match the finance team's expected values, and existing API contract tests pass unchanged.
`shipments/tasks.py`의 `sync_carrier_status` Celery task가 carrier API에서 429 받으면 retry 없이 그냥 성공 처리돼서 배송 상태가 몇 시간씩 안 바뀌는 문제가 있어요. `autoretry_for`랑 backoff 제대로 걸어주고, 429일 때 `Retry-After` 헤더도 반영되게 고쳐주세요.

The nightly meter-readings ETL (`etl/meter_readings.py`) drops the last reading of every month when it resamples to hourly. I think it's the `resample('H', closed='left')` combined with the end-date filter in `load_window()`. Go test-first: add a failing pytest case using a small CSV fixture with a reading at 23:45 on the 31st, then fix it so the test passes without changing output for the other days.
hydration mismatch on /listings/[id] from toLocaleDateString in ListingHeader.tsx, fix it

Fix duplicate orders on checkout in the Next.js storefront.
- Symptom: support reports ~40 double charges last week; logs show two `POST /api/orders` calls within 200ms from the same session
- `app/checkout/CheckoutForm.tsx` disables the button only after `await createPaymentIntent()` resolves, so fast double-clicks get through
- Disable the submit immediately on click and show the pending state via `useFormStatus`
- Server side: make `app/api/orders/route.ts` honor an `Idempotency-Key` header (generate one per checkout attempt on the client) and return the existing order on a repeat
- Store keys in the existing `idempotency_keys` table via Prisma with a 24h expiry
Acceptance: a Playwright test that double-clicks Pay creates exactly one order, and a repeated request with the same key returns 200 with the same order id.

강의 수강 페이지에서 레슨 완료 체크하면 `useMarkLessonComplete` mutation은 성공하는데 사이드바 진도율이 새로고침 전까지 안 바뀌어요. `hooks/useCourseProgress.ts` 쪽 React Query key가 `['progress', courseId]`랑 `['course-progress', courseId]`로 섞여 있는 것 같은데 invalidate 제대로 되게 고쳐주세요.

In the CMS editor, pasting from Google Docs into `components/editor/RichTextField.tsx` strips all links, because our sanitize step in `lib/sanitizeHtml.ts` drops `<a>` tags whose href has a `google.com/url?q=` wrapper. Keep the diff minimal: just unwrap the redirect to the real URL and allow it through the existing allowlist, no new packages, and don't touch the toolbar code.
goroutine leak in telemetry ingest worker when device disconnects mid-batch, see internal/ingest/worker.go

Our matchmaking service sometimes puts the same player into two lobbies at once. I suspect a race in `internal/lobby/queue.go` where `Dequeue` reads the slice under an RLock and then removes under a separate Lock. Can you fix it so dequeue is atomic, and make sure `go test -race ./internal/lobby/...` stays clean?

Bug: webhook deliveries to merchants silently stop after a Redis failover.
- Service: `cmd/webhook-dispatcher`, consumer loop in `internal/dispatch/consumer.go`
- After failover, `BLPOP` returns an error, we log it once and the loop exits; the process keeps running so k8s never restarts it
- Requirements: reconnect with exponential backoff (cap 30s, with jitter), keep the loop alive, and expose a `dispatcher_consumer_up` Prometheus metric
- The readiness endpoint `/readyz` should return 503 while the consumer is down
- No changes to the go-redis client version
Acceptance: an integration test using miniredis that restarts the server mid-run shows deliveries resuming within one backoff window.
`pkg/scheduler/slots.go`에서 병원 예약 가능 시간 계산할 때 `time.Truncate`를 써서 KST 기준으로 하루 경계가 9시간 밀리고 있어요. 그래서 오전 9시 전 슬롯이 전날로 잡히는데, location 기준으로 날짜 자르도록 고쳐주고 테이블 테스트도 추가해 주세요.

The fleet tracking API returns a 500 on `GET /vehicles/{id}/route` when a vehicle has zero GPS points, because `internal/route/simplify.go` indexes `points[0]` unconditionally. Fix it and keep it backward compatible: an empty route should come back as `{"points": []}` with 200, the same shape existing clients already parse, not a 404 or null.
panic 'byte index is not a char boundary' in src/parser/csv_row.rs on utf-8 names

Our IoT firmware update server deadlocks under load. In `src/updates/registry.rs`, `assign_rollout` holds the `devices` tokio `Mutex` across an `.await` on the S3 presign call, and `heartbeat` takes the locks in the opposite order. Can you restructure it so we never hold a lock across an await and the lock order is consistent?
주문 매칭 엔진 `src/book/order_book.rs`에서 같은 가격에 들어온 주문이 시간 순서대로 체결이 안 되고 가끔 뒤에 온 주문이 먼저 체결돼요. `BinaryHeap`에 timestamp만 넣고 있어서 동일 timestamp일 때 순서가 보장 안 되는 것 같은데, sequence number 기준으로 FIFO 보장되게 고쳐주세요.

The analytics query service leaks memory: RSS climbs about 200MB/hour in prod. I believe the `Arc<QueryCache>` in `src/cache/mod.rs` gets cloned into every spawned task and the eviction path in `evict_expired` never runs because the interval task is dropped. Plan before coding: write up the suspected ownership cycle and how you'll verify it with a test, then make the fix.
LazyInitializationException on GET /api/claims/{id} after spring boot 3.3 upgrade

Hotel booking confirmations show the wrong check-in date for guests in Australia. `BookingMapper.toDto` in the Spring Boot service converts `LocalDate` through `java.util.Date` using the server default timezone, so it shifts by a day. Please fix the mapping to keep it as a plain `LocalDate` end to end and add a test that runs with `-Duser.timezone=Australia/Sydney`.

Fix the payroll export job writing duplicate rows.
- Job: `PayrollExportJob` (Spring Batch, Kotlin) in `payroll-service/src/main/kotlin/.../export/`
- Symptom: when the job restarts after a failure on chunk 14, rows from chunks 1-13 are exported again to the SFTP CSV
- The `JdbcPagingItemReader` has `saveState = false` and the writer appends instead of resuming
- Requirements: make the step restartable from the last committed chunk, writer must be idempotent per run id
- Use the existing `BATCH_STEP_EXECUTION_CONTEXT` tables, no new tables
Acceptance: a Spring Batch test that forces a failure on chunk 3 and restarts produces exactly one row per employee.

Our inventory service throws `OptimisticLockException` storms during flash sales and then returns 409 to the warehouse scanners even when stock is available. The retry in `StockReservationService.reserve()` catches the wrong exception type because the JPA one gets wrapped in `ObjectOptimisticLockingFailureException`. Security first: while fixing the retry, make sure the error response stops leaking the entity class name and SQL state to the client.
android compose: LazyColumn scroll jumps to top on every sensor reading update, fix

In the Flutter fitness app, the workout timer keeps running correctly in the foreground but shows the wrong elapsed time after the app is backgrounded for a few minutes on iOS. `lib/workout/timer_controller.dart` just increments a counter in a `Timer.periodic`. Can you change it to derive elapsed time from a start timestamp so it survives backgrounding?

Fix the crash in the SwiftUI telehealth app when a video visit ends.
- Crash: `EXC_BAD_ACCESS` in `VisitRoomViewModel.deinit`, around 2% of sessions in the last release per Crashlytics
- `VisitRoomViewModel` registers a `NotificationCenter` observer with a closure capturing `self` strongly and never removes it
- The AVAudioSession route-change handler also fires after the view model is gone
- Requirements: use `[weak self]` captures, store tokens and remove them in `deinit` or switch to async `notifications(named:)` tied to the task lifetime
- Must keep supporting iOS 16
Acceptance: ending a visit 20 times in a row in the simulator with Zombies enabled shows no crash, and the existing `VisitRoomViewModelTests` pass.

React Native 배달 앱에서 Android만 `PushNotificationHandler.ts`에서 알림 탭하면 앱이 cold start일 때 주문 상세 화면으로 안 넘어가고 홈에서 멈춰요. `getInitialNotification()`이 navigation ready 전에 호출되는 것 같은데 `NavigationContainer` onReady 이후에 처리되게 고쳐주세요.

The `RateQuoteService` in `shipping/quotes.py` has grown to about 900 lines, and the UPS, FedEx and DHL branches all live in one `calculate()` method. Can you split each carrier into its own class behind a common `CarrierRater` protocol, without changing the public `calculate()` signature?

Goal: pull the appointment slot logic out of the Django view in our clinic scheduling app.
- Move the availability computation from `scheduling/views.py` (`AvailableSlotsView.get`) into `scheduling/services/availability.py`
- Make it pure functions that take a provider, a date range and existing bookings, with no ORM calls inside
- Keep the queries in a thin `scheduling/repositories.py`, and have the view just wire the two together
- Timezone handling (clinic local tz, DST edges) must behave exactly as it does today
Acceptance: `tests/test_slots_api.py` passes unmodified and API responses are identical.
`etl/transforms.py`에 있는 pandas 변환 함수들이 전역 변수 `CONFIG`를 직접 참조하고 있어서 테스트하기가 너무 힘들어요. 설정값을 인자로 받도록 바꿔주시고, 호출하는 쪽인 `jobs/daily_rollup.py`도 같이 수정해주세요.

Replace the raw dict handling in `app/routers/grades.py` with Pydantic v2 models for submissions and grade updates. Keep it backward compatible: the mobile app reads these responses, so the JSON shape and field names must stay identical. Run the existing pytest suite before and after to confirm nothing changed.
move useCartTotals logic out of CheckoutPage.tsx into hooks/useCartTotals.ts

Goal: unify the three HTTP helpers in our newsroom CMS (Next.js app router).
- `lib/api.ts`, `lib/fetcher.ts` and `utils/http.ts` duplicate each other; replace them with a single `lib/apiClient.ts`
- Expose typed `get/post/patch/del` methods and attach the auth header from the session in one place
- On non-2xx responses, throw an `ApiError` carrying the status and the parsed body
- Update every call site under `app/(editor)/**` and `app/(admin)/**`
Constraints: the actual network requests must not change (same URLs, headers, methods). Delete the old files at the end.
Acceptance: `pnpm typecheck` and `pnpm test` are green.
`components/TripMap.tsx`가 600줄이 넘는데 지도 렌더링, 드라이버 위치 폴링, 요금 계산이 전부 섞여 있어요. 폴링은 커스텀 훅으로, 요금 계산은 `lib/fare.ts`로 분리해주시고 UI 동작은 지금 그대로 유지해주세요.

Convert `src/matchmaking/queue.js` and `src/matchmaking/elo.js` in our game server to TypeScript with strict mode on. Minimal diff please: no logic changes and no renamed exports, just types and whatever `tsc --strict` needs. If something can't be typed cleanly, leave a TODO instead of rewriting it.
extract retry logic from internal/payments/stripe_client.go into a shared retry pkg

Our `device/registry.go` uses a package-level `map[string]*Device` behind a global mutex, and every handler reaches into it directly. Can you wrap it in a `Registry` struct with proper methods and inject it into the HTTP handlers from `cmd/hub/main.go` instead?
`internal/inventory/handler.go`에서 에러를 전부 문자열로 비교하고 있는데 (`err.Error() == "not found"` 이런 식으로요), 패키지 레벨에 미리 정의한 에러 값과 `errors.Is`를 쓰도록 바꿔주세요. HTTP 상태 코드 매핑 결과는 지금과 똑같아야 합니다.

Split the 1,400-line `pkg/telemetry/ingest.go` in our fleet tracking service into separate files for decoding, validation and persistence, all within the same package. Work test-first: write characterization tests that pin the current output for the sample payloads in `testdata/`, then do the split so we can prove nothing changed.
replace unwrap()s in src/parser/ledger.rs with proper Result and thiserror

In `crates/feed-gen/src/rss.rs`, our podcast host builds XML by concatenating `String`s with `format!` all over the place. Could you refactor it to use `quick-xml`'s writer so escaping is handled in one spot, while keeping the generated feeds byte-identical for the fixtures in `tests/fixtures/`?

Goal: break the `robot-core` crate in our warehouse robotics repo into a Cargo workspace.
- New `robot-proto` crate for message types and serde impls, with no tokio dependency
- New `robot-nav` crate for path planning (A*, costmap code from `src/nav/`)
- `robot-core` keeps the async runtime and re-exports the public API, so downstream `fleet-svc` compiles with no changes
- No circular dependencies between crates
Acceptance: `cargo test --workspace` and `cargo clippy --workspace -- -D warnings` pass, and incremental build time after touching `robot-nav` does not get worse.

Refactor `src/cache/mod.rs` in our CDN edge service so `LruStore` is generic over the key type instead of hard-coding `String`. Add no new dependencies and keep the hot path allocation-free. Run the criterion benches in `benches/cache.rs` before and after, and include both sets of numbers.
convert OrderDto and friends to java records, drop lombok from billing module

`ClaimService` in the claims module uses `@Autowired` field injection for twelve dependencies, so the unit tests are a mess of reflection. Switch it to constructor injection and split the fraud-scoring calls out into a `FraudCheckService`, since they're half the class anyway.

Goal: move hotel booking state transitions out of `BookingController.kt` into the domain model.
- Introduce a sealed class `BookingState` (Pending, Confirmed, CheckedIn, CheckedOut, Cancelled)
- Put the transitions as methods on `Booking` that throw `IllegalTransitionException` on invalid moves
- The controller should only map HTTP to and from the domain, with no status checks left in it
- Leave the JPA entity mapping and column values unchanged, so no Flyway migration is needed
Acceptance: `./gradlew test` passes and the existing MockMvc tests are not edited.
`NotificationSender` 클래스에 SMS, 이메일, 푸시 분기가 if-else로 다 들어가 있는데, 채널별로 인터페이스 구현체로 나눠주세요. Spring에서 `List<NotificationChannel>`으로 주입받는 방식이면 좋겠어요.

Migrate `ShipmentRepository` in the Maven `tracking-core` module from raw `JdbcTemplate` queries with string-concatenated SQL to Spring Data JDBC. Plan before coding: list each query, its replacement, and any you think should stay native, then wait for my OK before touching any files.
break up WorkoutDetailView.swift into smaller subviews, it's 800 lines

Our banking app's `TransferViewModel` calls Retrofit and the Room DAO directly and handles the caching itself. Could you move that into a `TransferRepository` injected with Hilt, so the ViewModel only deals with UI state and the Compose screen stays the same?

Goal: replace the setState mess in `lib/screens/order_tracking_screen.dart` (food delivery app) with Riverpod.
- Add separate providers for order status polling, courier location and ETA
- Turn the screen into a `ConsumerWidget` with no business logic in `build()`
- Keep the existing `OrderApi` class as is and wrap it in a provider rather than rewriting it
- Cancel the polling timer when the screen is disposed, as it is now
Acceptance: the widget tests in `test/order_tracking_test.dart` are updated and pass, and there is no visual change.
`src/screens/ChatRoom.tsx`에 소켓 연결 코드가 컴포넌트 안에 다 들어있는데, `useChatSocket` 훅으로 빼주세요. 재연결 로직과 언마운트 시 cleanup 동작은 지금과 똑같이 유지해야 돼요.
add pytest cases for parse_dosage() in pharmacy/rx_parser.py, cover mg/mcg edge cases

Can you write tests for `RateQuoter.quote()` in logistics/rates.py? It returns negative totals when a discount code exceeds the base fare. I want a failing regression test in place before I touch the fix.

Goal: get test coverage on the enrollment waitlist logic in `school/enrollment/services.py` (Django 4.2, pytest-django).
- Cover `promote_from_waitlist(section_id)` for these cases: seat frees up, section full, student already enrolled elsewhere at the same time slot, and an expired hold.
- Use factory_boy factories in `tests/factories.py`. Add `SectionFactory` and `WaitlistEntryFactory` if they're missing.
- Test the `select_for_update` path with two concurrent promotions using `transaction=True` tests.
